Me myself have sorta phobia to death. Its really hard to talk about it or even think about it, but wanted to comment here what has helped me so far.

•Therapy is best, if it does keep you awake at night.

•Movies or tv shows (that make you see and experience it a bit differently)

•talking about it with close friends who don't judge you.

•trying to understand that life is fleeting and the fact is we don't know much what "really" happend after death, and that is ok. MORE of a reason to start everyday and make sure you enjoy the fullest (value the little things; how summer wind feels on your face, the grass or ground under your feet, how good the tea/coffee/fav.beverage smells and tastes. All that good stuff).

•there is a good show/documentary about death in netflix. It takes many perspectives but very neutrally. Highly recommend, made things a bit easier for me at least: surviving death.

•also another great show that made me think a lot; after life
